steps.code:
# Identify friends to add (phone friends not in venmo) and remove (venmo friends not in phone)
phone_emails = {c['email'] for c in phone_friends}
venmo_emails = {f['email'] for f in venmo_friends}
to_add = phone_emails - venmo_emails
to_remove = venmo_emails - phone_emails
print("To add:", to_add)
print("To remove:", to_remove)

# Add friends
for email in to_add:
    result = apis.venmo.add_friend(user_email=email, access_token=venmo_token)
    print(f"Added {email}: {result}")

# Remove friends
for email in to_remove:
    result = apis.venmo.remove_friend(user_email=email, access_token=venmo_token)
    print(f"Removed {email}: {result}")

# Verify the final venmo friends list matches phone friends
venmo_friends_final = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    venmo_friends_final.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
final_venmo_emails = {f['email'] for f in venmo_friends_final}
print("Final venmo friends count:", len(final_venmo_emails))
print("Phone friends count:", len(phone_emails))
print("Match:", final_venmo_emails == phone_emails)
if final_venmo_emails != phone_emails:
    print("Missing from venmo:", phone_emails - final_venmo_emails)
    print("Extra in venmo:", final_venmo_emails - phone_emails)
